continuity.arc: Rama allies with Sugriva, searches for Sita, crosses the ocean and defeats Ravana, then recounts later events before the poet closes with a prayer to Guruvayurappan.
continuity.style: Traditional matte South Indian temple-mural painting: firm dark drawn contours, broad opaque mineral color fields, shallow decorative space, restrained facial modeling, full bleed without an outer border, earth ochre, maroon, warm cream, muted foliage green and quiet blue. D001 S004/S008 are rendering references only; chapter photos guide story and composition only. No glossy shading, metallic gold, text, watermark, logo or signature.
continuity.character_continuity: D035 local provisional character contracts govern Rama, Sita, Lakshmana, Hanuman, Sugriva, Vali, Ravana, Vibhishana, Sampati and Garuda. Ordinary humanlike and vanara characters have two naturally connected arms and two legs; Hanuman and vanaras have one attached tail where specified. Ravana has ten heads only in S007, on one connected body with two arms; no head is detached. Rama has muted blue skin and no Krishna peacock feather. Guruvayurappan follows the approved identity bible and its copied identity reference only; the two D001 images govern rendering. The selected older clean-shaven Bhattathiri reference is used only in S010. No art in this plan is approved.
continuity.production: Landscape-only native production: ten independent 16:9 compositions. Portrait companions are paused and must not be generated or simulated by crop. All generated candidates remain unapproved.

scene_brief.source_summary: The user-supplied stanza-1 caption describes Rama's alliance with Sugriva, strength demonstration, Vali episode and rainy retreat; this composition isolates the strength demonstration.

stanzas.alt: Rama demonstrates his strength by sending one arrow through seven shala trees as Sugriva and Hanuman watch in the Matanga forest.
stanzas.reference_guidance: Use 001 and 003 as story/composition references only. The old images may show several episodes and different renderings; generate one coherent moment. D001 references control matte paint only.
